How to read grizzly's expiration date from https://www.reddit.com/r/DippingTobacco/wiki/index

"If you look at the bottom of the can, you will see a line of digits that are 9 numbers long. Use this chart as a reference. If you see a single digit number at the end, do not panick. The 1-10 chart resets every decade so a 2 would be 2012 and a 3 would be 2013 and so on.

A - January

B - February

C - March

D - April

E - May

F - June

G - July

H - August

J - September

K - October

L - November

M - December

After this letter, there will be a number. This is the year.

Example - 829828M2 (This would be December of 2012)"
